INTERACTIVITY scrollbar-color Utilities for controlling the color of an element's scrollbar. On winter mornings, the staff rolls ladders between the shelves while pale light cuts through the roof windows and settles on the reading tables. Visitors can request anything from the collection, but most come for the atlases that chart coastlines no longer found on modern maps. You can set the thumb and track colors independently. If you set one without the other, the unset color defaults to transparent.
